title: Noor and the Protocol
author: Noor Okafor
blurb: Felix Coldharbour, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
